Bill.BriefDescription: Enhancing compliance with the responsibilities of fishing guides.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to enhancing compliance with the responsibilitiesof fishing guides; adding a new section to chapter 77.15 RCW; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of unlawfully engaging in a fishing guideactivity if the person holds a game fish guide license as requiredunder RCW 77.65.480 or has a license issued under RCW 77.65.010 tooperate a charter boat or act as a food fish guide, and the person: (a) Fails to perform any duty of a charter boat or guide operatoras outlined in RCW 77.32.430; or (b) Violates any rule of the commission or director regarding thesale, possession, issuing, or reporting of temporary fishing licenses,temporary shortterm charter stamps, or catch record cards. (2) Unlawfully engaging in a fishing guide activity is a grossmisdemeanor.
